title: 10″ Dopezilla Basilisk Dab Rig – Black
description:
Description
The Serpent King is here, Basilisk is a clear beaker dab rig with coloured accents on the mouthpiece, base and monster logo. It features a drum percolator to make your hit so smooth, it will go down in hiss-tory.
The 10” Basilisk beaker comes delivered with a male 14.5mm quartz banger. A banger is the preferred method for dabbing, making it easier and more efficient to use than typical accessories of the past.
If you’re looking for a solid and nefarious beaker dab rig to add to your glass collection, you have found your ideal piece. Purchase Basilisk and the rest of the Dopezilla collection for the best available prices.
High quality borosilicate glass.
Beaker base.
14.5mm Female Joint.
Male 14.5mm quartz banger.
Drum percolator.
No carb hole.
Colourful accents on the mouthpiece, bowl and monster logo.
